id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|195d: "I meant to go home, but I was asked to help rebuild this village. I'll stay a little longer.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|196f: "Monks gathered in a hurry at the Grand Training Ground. It seems Master Nima ordered it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|199b: "I asked Sampo to let me take the Warrior's Gauntlet, but I lost at the very first trial...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19a9: "Is there truly anyone in this world who can conquer trials that hard? It's impossible for someone like me...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19c7: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the Master's palace. The High Priest is waiting inside.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d8: "Welcome to the Master's palace. Built in ancient times, it's a famous structure even in Erdrea.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e6: "After the first Master built it, it was remodeled again and again until it grew this large.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f8: "High Priest Sampo has prepared a special training for you, the Warrior's Gauntlet, and awaits you at the Grand Training Ground.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a09: "If you want to raise your power, please take on the training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a39: "If you want to raise your power, please take on the training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a15: "Welcome, Luminary. Pass through this palace to the Grand Training Ground. The Master awaits you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a29: "Master Nima has prepared a special training for you, the Warrior's Gauntlet, and awaits you at the Grand Training Ground.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a9f: "Ugh... training day after day, yet I couldn't even save one trainee. I'm ashamed of myself.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aad: "Luminary, I leave the rest to you. Please help the trainee.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aba: "Luminary. Thank you for helping the trainee who went to the summit.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ae4: "Luminary. Thank you for helping the trainee who went to the summit.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac5: "My injuries from the monsters healed, and I could resume training. A healthy body is best.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aef: "My injuries from the monsters healed, and I could resume training. A healthy body is best.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad5: "That plump old man was the legendary disciple, Lord Rab... You can't judge people by looks.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aff: "That plump old man was the legendary disciple, Lord Rab... You can't judge people by looks.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0e: "A lovely round tail... a pretty, bouncy pair of rabbit ears... a slender, sexy figure.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b46: "A lovely round tail... a pretty, bouncy pair of rabbit ears... a slender, sexy figure.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b7c: "A lovely round tail... a pretty, bouncy pair of rabbit ears... a slender, sexy figure.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b17: "So this is the bunny girl of my dreams. I've only seen one in naughty books. Talking to one moves me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b4f: "So this is the bunny girl of my dreams. I've only seen one in naughty books. Talking to one moves me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b85: "So this is the bunny girl of my dreams. I've only seen one in naughty books. Talking to one moves me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b28: "Thanks to you, Yggdrasil has revived. The severed cycle of life will return, and new life will be born.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b38: "Thank you so much for restoring Erdrea to its true form.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b60: "Luminary {var:1} and Lord Rab, the legendary disciple! It's an honor to meet you both!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b68: "Please train together here at the Grand Training Ground! Sweating and training with you two is my long-held dream!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b9c: "{var:1}, glad to see you well. I worried since we were separated at Yggdrasil, but you look fine.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1baa: "Me? As you see, I'm fine. I've trained here this whole time in this training ground the Master recreated with her magic.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bba: "But if you're here, you should have told me... The Master is as mischievous as ever.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bca: "What happened since then? Are your companions safe?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bd1: "I have many questions, but now isn't the time. Let's hear the Master first.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1be1: "Erdwin's technique, the Overlord slash. Once you learn it, you'll be unstoppable.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bec: "But in a duel I won't go easy. I'll test your newly learned secret art, so be ready.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d9d: "This road leads to the summit of Mount Pang Lai. Many monsters roam the path, so those without permission can't enter.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dac: "If you want to go to the summit, first go to Angri-La and get High Priest Sampo's permission.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dbc: "Ah, Luminary. You're going to rescue the trainee who went to the summit. Please be careful.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dcd: "I was startled when the High Priest and Lord Hendrik came down the path with you and a shriveled Lord Rab.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ddb: "But seeing you now, you both seem fine. That's truly a relief.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1de8: "The rumor that you defeated the Dark One has reached even Mount Pang Lai.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1df1: "Thank you for defeating the evil Dark One without regard for your own safety.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e00: "This road leads to the summit of Mount Pang Lai. Many monsters roam the path, so be careful if you head there.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e25: "There was a trainee who forced his way to the summit despite our warnings. Fearless, or perhaps foolish...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e34: "Our comrades went to look for him, but he entered the monster-filled path, and I doubt he's still safe.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e43: "If you don't want to end up like that trainee, don't enter the mountain path.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e4e: "Luminary, the summit of Mount Pang Lai is reached by the mountain path east of this village. Monsters are many, so be careful.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e5f: "Luminary, the summit of Mount Pang Lai is reached by the path east of the cave to the village. Beware of monsters.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e77: "This martial artist wants to become a disciple here. Normally we don't take outsiders, but now we need every fighter.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ee0: "This martial artist wants to become a disciple here. Normally we don't take outsiders, but now we need every fighter.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e88: "In times like these, one can't be picky. I'll make an exception and allow it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ef0: "In times like these, one can't be picky. I'll make an exception and allow it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e97: "Places away from Yggdrasil escaped the shock wave, but they say hordes of monsters are attacking.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea7: "...Ugh. How far will the Dark One go to torment us?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb2: "Peace has returned to Erdrea, but rebuilding Angri-La is only beginning. Would you help?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ec3: "The Dark One Mordegon was defeated, but by dropping Yggdrasil he cost many lives.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ed0: "Couldn't we have done something before this... It's pointless to speculate, but I can't help thinking so.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f00: "The monsters revived with the Luminary's star's fall can't be defeated even by the Master's power.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f0c: "Only the Luminary can save Erdrea now. Please, I beg you.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f1e: "Heh heh, soon now... Soon I'll become a bouncy young girl!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f24: "Then I'll give you a puff-puff to comfort you, since you look like you can't get a date.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f38: "A-at last... At last I've become a bouncy young girl!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f3e: "...That's what Grandpa said, but he looked like the same old Grandpa to me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f46: "He's old enough to give up his dream of becoming a bouncy young girl already...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f5a: "No retreat... backs to the wall... The outcome of battle depends on your resolve. One who expects to lose can't win.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f96: "No retreat... backs to the wall... The outcome of battle depends on your resolve. One who expects to lose can't win.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f6b: "However strong the foe, to win, believe in yourself and burn with fighting spirit. Trust in victory always.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa7: "However strong the foe, to win, believe in yourself and burn with fighting spirit. Trust in victory always.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f7a: "This is Angri-La's creed. The monks keep it and train day after day.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fb6: "This is Angri-La's creed. The monks keep it and train day after day.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fc5: "If you throw yourself into battle ahead, this creed will serve you. Would you like to embody it?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd4: "You use a certain link technique to defeat a powerful monster. How about it? Will you try?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fe7: "I see. For those who throw themselves into battle, this training never hurts. Come back if you feel like it.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2000: "A fine answer. I can tell from it that you've crossed many crises and fought many powerful foes.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2011: "As for the training, a monster called a Snow dragon lives outside Angri-La. A very strong monster that appears only by day.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2020: "As for the training... if you leave the village by day and walk the rocky mountain just outside, a Snow dragon appears.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|202f: "Use the link technique Last resolve to defeat that Snow dragon.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|206c: "Use the link technique Last resolve to defeat that Snow dragon.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2037: "Last resolve raises attack and lowers defense. You face it with literally your back to the wall.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2075: "Last resolve raises attack and lowers defense. You face it with literally your back to the wall.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204f: "As for the training, a monster called a Snow dragon lives outside Angri-La. A very strong monster that appears only by day.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|205e: "As for the training, leave the village by day and walk the rocky mountain just outside. A Snow dragon appears.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2094: "Splendid. I can tell from the aura you give off. It seems you've completed the training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20a0: "The creed will serve you in battles with strong foes ahead. Battle is resolve. Remember that.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20b0: "This is my token for you who completed Angri-La's training. Please accept it without hesitation.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20bd: "...Incidentally, a man named Rab once ran from strong foes and never completed this training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20cd: "His reason was apparently to get punished by the Master on purpose... It leaves me speechless.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20fb: "His reason was apparently to get punished by the Master on purpose... It leaves me speechless.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20d9: "Do not be like Rab... This training is harsh, but I hope everyone in the village fulfills it with distinction.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2107: "Do not be like Rab... This training is harsh, but I hope everyone in the village fulfills it with distinction.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ec: "...Incidentally, a man named Rab once ran from strong foes and never completed this training.

id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2137: "I was recognized for my training and entrusted with guarding these honored people here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2143: "If need be, I'm prepared to use my well-trained body as a shield and protect them to the end.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2159: "Because of my duty to protect the honored ones, I have never once neglected physical training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2167: "This body, trained and trained, is like a lump of hard metal! I pride myself on beating even a Liquid metal slime.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2174: "Yes! This body is my pride. No ordinary weapon can pierce my body!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2180: "Care to test it? Can you prepare a weapon that pierces my steel body?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2194: "Of course not. A weapon that pierces my body is not easy to come by.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ab: "Ha ha ha ha! Such confidence! Very well, I accept your challenge!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b4: "But my victory is clear... For the only thing that could pierce this body is the legendary Empire blade+3!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21c2: "And the Empire blade+3 can only be made by the legendary technique Fun-Sized Forge. A rare masterpiece, hard to obtain.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21d1: "I believe the Empire blade recipe is a reward of the Warrior's Gauntlet, but I doubt you could obtain it!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21fe: "I believe the Empire blade recipe is a reward of the Warrior's Gauntlet, but I doubt you could obtain it!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21dd: "If you ever get the Empire blade+3, equip it and talk to me. Though it's surely impossible! Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|220a: "If you ever get the Empire blade+3, equip it and talk to me. Though it's surely impossible! Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21f3: "If you want to pierce my body, prepare a weapon called the Empire blade+3 with the Fun-Sized Forge.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2225: "Th-that weapon you have equipped... Could it be the Empire blade+3?! You made it with the Fun-Sized Forge?!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2230: "I-I bow before you!! To think you'd prepare such a weapon!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2238: "With that weapon, a critical hit would pierce even the most trained body like a bundle of straw...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2244: "Had an evil person wielded that weapon, I'd have failed to protect the honored ones and ended Angri-La's history...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2253: "Nothing is perfect, and arrogance is wrong... I'd like to offer you a modest thanks for showing me that!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2267: "When I confessed to the honored ones that I'd noticed my mistake, they forgave me everything.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2272: "And they thanked you for showing me, urging me to devote myself more to training and duty.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|227d: "I swear I'll never forget your deed, and will keep it in my heart all my life!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22a7: "I study the ancient documents of Angri-La daily.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b0: "This village was built in ancient times and has a long history, so many fascinating books lie asleep here.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22d2: "Normally a caster uses only their own magic to cast spells, so their power is naturally limited.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22e2: "But after years of research, I created a spell that takes in power dwelling in the world to vastly raise magic.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22f5: "I sealed this spell in three books and stored them on the first to third floors of the Library of Wisdom east of Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2306: "If someone fights evil again and seeks my spell, recite these words before the three books.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2315: "Book sealing my wisdom, by your master's name, release your bonds...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2381: "Book sealing my wisdom, by your master's name, release your bonds...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23b2: "Book sealing my wisdom, by your master's name, release your bonds...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|231f: "...Sorry. I study the ancient documents of Angri-La daily.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|232a: "That was a sealing incantation said to be left by the legendary wizard Uranos. I found it in the palace library recently.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|233a: "If Lord Rab learned the magic-boosting spell in the sealed books, it would surely help in battles ahead.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2349: "{var:1}, you travel the world, so you must know where the Library of Wisdom is. Would you look for these sealed books?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2360: "...I see. Too bad. Well, {var:1} is busy, so it can't be helped.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2372: "Thank you! The sealed books are said to be stored on the first to third floors of the Library of Wisdom east of Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|238b: "Reciting these words should break the seals. After reading all three sealed books, report to me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23bc: "Reciting these words should break the seals. After reading all three sealed books, report to me.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23a2: "The books Uranos left are said to be stored on the first to third floors of the Library of Wisdom east of Snaerfelt.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23cf: "{var:1}, did you read all of Uranos's sealed books?
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23d7: "I see... The three sealed books are in the Library of Wisdom. Tell me when you learn what comes next.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23f9:
{var:1} told him what
the sealed books say!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23fe: "...Endless skies, deep seas, majestic earth. Countless spirits dwelling in all things of Erdrea...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|240c: "To protect this beautiful Erdrea and the people living in it from the evil threatening the world...
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2417: "Lend me your sublime power for a time!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|241e: "...I see. Mastering this spell's secret would greatly amplify one's magic.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|242a: "Even if it's hard for a commoner like me, Lord Rab, a veteran sage, will surely grasp this secret.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2437:
Rab mastered Uranos's spell!
Rab's attack magic and healing magic
each rose by 50!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2443: "Just by reciting Uranos's spell, he mastered its secret. As expected of the legendary disciple, Lord Rab!
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|244f: "Uranos, who left this book for posterity, must be happy that someone inherited the spell he devised.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|245e: "I too satisfied my intellectual curiosity reading the sealed books left by an ancient hero. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2474: "Gaining the secret art left by Uranos just by reading the old text. As expected of the legendary disciple, Lord Rab.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2481: "I'll follow Lord Rab's example and devote body and soul to training.
id./param/region/r015.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2496:
As expected of the
legendary disciple...

tm.「故郷に 戻るつもりでいたが\n この郷の復興に協力するよう 頼まれてな。\n: "I meant to go home, but I was asked to help rebuild this village. I'll stay a little longer.
tm.「修行僧たちが あわてた様子で\n ドゥルダの大修練場に 集まっていたぞ。\n: "Monks gathered in a hurry at the Grand Training Ground. It seems Master Nima ordered it.
tm.「サンポ殿に お願いして\n 連武討魔行に 挑戦したのだが\n いちばん 最初の: "I asked Sampo to let me take the Warrior's Gauntlet, but I lost at the very first trial...
tm.「あれほど難しい試練を 制覇できる者が\n 本当に この世にいるのだろうか。\n: "Is there truly anyone in this world who can conquer trials that hard? It's impossible for someone like me...
tm.「勇者さま よくぞ おいでくださいました。\n ここが 大師の宮殿です。\n 中: "Welcome, Luminary. This is the Master's palace. The High Priest is waiting inside.
tm.「大師の宮殿へ ようこそ。\n この宮殿は いにしえの時代に建てられた\n ロト: "Welcome to the Master's palace. Built in ancient times, it's a famous structure even in Erdrea.
tm.「なんでも 初代大師によって建設された後\n 何度も 改築を繰り返して\n ここ: "After the first Master built it, it was remodeled again and again until it grew this large.
tm.「サンポ大僧正が 勇者さまのために\n 連武討魔行という 特別な修行を用意して\: "High Priest Sampo has prepared a special training for you, the Warrior's Gauntlet, and awaits you at the Grand Training Ground.
tm.「自らのチカラを 高めたいと思ったら\n ぜひ 修行に挑戦してください。: "If you want to raise your power, please take on the training.
tm.「勇者さま よくぞ おいでくださいました。\n この宮殿を通り ドゥルダの大修練: "Welcome, Luminary. Pass through this palace to the Grand Training Ground. The Master awaits you.
tm.「ニマ大師が 勇者さまのために\n 連武討魔行という 特別な修行を用意して\n: "Master Nima has prepared a special training for you, the Warrior's Gauntlet, and awaits you at the Grand Training Ground.
tm.「ううう……日々 修行を積みかさねながら\n ひとりの修行者さえ 救えないなんて: "Ugh... training day after day, yet I couldn't even save one trainee. I'm ashamed of myself.
